title: Population Count

forbidden.message: $countones / $onehot are not allowed: build the counter yourself

constraints: `count` (0 – 16) is the number of `1` bits in `x`.
hints: A `for` loop that adds each bit to an accumulator is a perfectly synthesizable adder chain.
For a shallower circuit, add bits in pairs, then 2-bit sums in pairs, and so on (an adder tree).
The SWAR trick: `x - ((x >> 1) & 16'h5555)` gives 2-bit counts, then combine with masks 0x3333, 0x0F0F, 0x00FF.
